# Aleksei Bespechnyi – International Sales & Business Development

> Professional portfolio and website of Aleksei Bespechnyi, based in Linz, Austria. Master student in Global Sales and Marketing at FH Upper Austria (Campus Steyr). Specialized in international B2B sales, business development, global client acquisition, and strategic pricing.

## About
- Aleksei Bespechnyi: Master of Arts student (1st academic year 2026–2028) in Global Sales and Marketing at FH Upper Austria, Campus Steyr (100% English-taught).
- Completed Bachelor of Arts in Global Sales & Marketing in June 2026 at FH Upper Austria.
- Exchange semester at Providence University in Taiwan (2024/25) focusing on Chinese language and Asian business culture.
- Austrian public speaking champion (SAG'S MULTI! 2020/21) with proven communication and negotiation skills.
- Core focus: international client acquisition, B2B dynamic pricing, market expansion, and strategic sales development.
- Proven results: +496% organic social reach and +124% organic search traffic (partyboss.at case).
